study.question: Does the useful native click-orthogonal auxiliary context direction require its original example assignment, beyond a zero-mean, click-orthogonal perturbation of equal row-space norm?
study.hypothesis: At this joint-model starting point, useful auxiliary supervision carries example-associated information in the occupied-row-centered click-orthogonal context cotangent O. Paired reassignment followed by orthogonality restoration and norm matching will reduce the positive-direction click-AUC benefit and attenuate the positive-minus-negative sign gap. The replacement jointly changes assignment and restores geometry, so a difference supports sensitivity to this structured direction replacement rather than pure assignment causality.

nearest_work.difference: Direct inherited source: C=centered auxiliary sum, K=centered click cotangent, P=proj_K(C), O=C-P. Native O AUC 0.6682887435699238 versus -O 0.667765764501977 in g3-r0048-orthogonal_reversed; adding native P gives 0.6682972490126902 in g3-r0048-centered_native_replay. Earlier studies test sign/P presence, not assignment replacement constrained to the same orthogonal subspace.

Earlier centered-component half-swap gives AUC 0.668067791345436 versus 0.6682972490126902 for g3-r0043-centered_aligned64. It changes click-relative geometry and lacks an orthogonal-assignment-by-sign factorial. This follow-up swaps O, restores K orthogonality and ||O||, and crosses assignment with sign.

study.proposed_difference: Add orthogonal_assignment=native|paired_reprojected. Let T exchange O rows at fixed half-batch distance only when both pair members have nonempty histories. Center T(O) on occupied rows, remove its global projection onto the same occupied-centered click K, and rescale the resulting R to ||O||_F. Exactly zero R maps to zero; K=0 leaves projection zero. Cross assignment with orthogonal_orientation=aligned|reversed to select +O, -O, +R or -R before the inherited single cast and addition of unmodified click cotangent. Every arm computes all alternatives. Private gradients/forward states at fixed parameters are unchanged. This is a first-order surrogate VJP, not an identity-forward derivative or new scalar objective.
predictions: Predeclared primary contrasts: AUC(+O)-AUC(+R)>0 and interaction [AUC(+O)-AUC(-O)]-[AUC(+R)-AUC(-R)]>0. AUC is the full 2,871,767-example validation click score; report all cell values and differences without choosing a favorable contrast post hoc.

Native +O/-O controls should reproduce g3-r0048-orthogonal_native_replay (0.6682887435699238) and g3-r0048-orthogonal_reversed (0.667765764501977) under the frozen seed; numerical bridge failures invalidate historical comparisons until diagnosed, while charged costs remain.

At fixed tensors, before the final cast, R and O should have zero empty rows, near-zero occupied feature-wise mean, and near-zero global dot product with centered K; nondegenerate R matches ||O||. Reversal preserves norm. Zero K/C/O and all-empty batches remain finite. These are row-space invariants, not parameter-space or optimizer-step claims.

Host preflight must check identical parameter/state hashes and predictions across all four cells; correct custom-VJP output/argument arity; untouched click cotangent and private module gradients; four-label loss/mask behavior; and bf16/float32/float64 inputs, empty and partial histories, even small batches and zero/nearzero gradients. Report residual orthogonality and norm errors before/after cast, eligible-pair fraction, permutation identity rate, cosine(O,R), projection-removal ratio, zero-replacement fraction and restoration scale. Do not add stateful instrumentation to candidate modules.

Expected parameter count is exactly 32,192,421 in all cells; unchanged inference path implies comparable measured throughput/latency, not an unmeasured efficiency gain. Record host allocated GPU/wall seconds, examples, peak memory, train/inference cost, all-task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, and existing fixed history-length slices with sample/positive/negative counts. Other slices require training-defined or predeclared bins and are exploratory.
falsifiers: If native replay controls fail or host invariants/private-gradient checks fail, treat the implementation as unvalidated; do not interpret AUC as mechanism evidence.
If +R reproducibly matches or exceeds +O and the assignment-by-sign interaction is absent, the proposed dependence on original example association is unsupported within this replacement family.
If +R and -R exhibit a sign gap comparable to +O and -O, sign-sensitive benefit may be generic to this orthogonal subspace or shared data structure rather than original assignment.

If eligible swapping is rare, R is effectively O, degenerate replacements are frequent, or normalization grossly amplifies nearzero residuals, the negative control is weak/confounded; a null or harm cannot establish the hypothesized mechanism.

A single-seed difference or deterministic replay is preliminary, not repeated mechanism support. AUC improvement alone does not establish a correct gradient-interference explanation or deployment validity.
alternative_explanations: Permutation plus reprojection jointly changes example association and orientation. Orthogonality restoration itself may remove useful information; matching a global row norm does not match individual row or field norms.

Global row-space orthogonality is lost under repeated-ID embedding accumulation and adaptive Adagrad preconditioning. Matched row norm does not imply matched embedding updates or equal learning-rate effects.
Fixed batch ordering and half-batch partners may share users or categories; swapping does not prove feature-label independence and can preserve useful correlations.

Different shared representations alter later task-private gradients and trajectories even though fixed-state private derivatives match. Aggregate vs task reduction and bf16 rounding previously changed results: g3-r0039-centered_replay/g3-r0040-task_direct/g3-r0041-collected_task32 motivate FP64 collection and explicit replay gates.

No current candidate diagnostics were requested in historical receipts; geometric assertions are prospective gates, not measured observations. Historical +O AUC is below incumbent g3-r0034-joint_aligned 0.668473871997858; this is an attribution study, not evidence of a new best model.

One seed, extensive adaptive validation reuse, rare auxiliary positives, offline delayed-action visibility, and benchmark whole-window preprocessing limit generalization; improvements do not establish production causality.
